purpose: Offline BKT/DKT/PAL-Net pipeline comparison; not evidence of learner benefit

field_notes.item_id: Actual CodingExercise UUID exported read-only from the product database
field_notes.item_title: Actual CodingExercise title from the product database
field_notes.lesson_code: Actual stable lesson code from the product database
field_notes.item_source: CODING_EXERCISE_DB means the item exists in the product database
field_notes.error_type: Simulated mistake category; not inferred from source code or actual submissions
field_notes.prereq_mastery_proxy: Pre-attempt estimate from earlier rows only; not true mastery
field_notes.attempt_index: Simulated repeated attempt on the same real catalog item
field_notes.time_calibrated: Calibrated to realistic human coding response times (90-900s+)
field_notes.anomalies_included: Includes 5-10% natural stochastic noise (guesses, slips, rapid spams)

limitations: Learner identities, histories, outcomes, time and error types are simulated
Behavioral parameters are assumptions rather than estimates from real users
Curriculum order follows the graph, but prerequisite mastery is not used to generate correctness
No hint interaction is simulated because the product does not expose a hint action
Real exercise IDs do not make the simulated histories real telemetry
These results cannot establish pedagogical efficacy or production readiness
